notes: If Cutnote restarts (after an update, or when you restart it), open pages now reload by themselves at the same moment, so the video never freezes.
Sidebar tabs: Notes, Library and Captions.
Library: animated components in collections. Drag one onto the video and it plays there right away, with a neon block on the timeline you can drag to retime.
Captions: pick a caption style for the whole video.
Updates: this button tells you when a new Cutnote is out and updates it in one click, or automatically.
